config.notes: UTS course pages (www.uts.edu.au/courses/<slug>) are server-rendered in the DOMESTIC view; no page JSON. Header facts: CODE (UTS code + CRICOS), DURATION, INTAKE (session names only, e.g. "Autumn Session 2027 Spring Session 2027" - no month names), COURSE FEES (Domestic (FT) only), LOCATION. IELTS in Admission requirements ("IELTS Academic: overall 6.5, writing 6.0"). International fees are NOT on course pages: central 2027 international course summary tables (PDF, fee per session) and the UTS fee search. Start months come from the central principal dates: Autumn session = February, Spring session = July; research sessions January and July. Intakes pattern only yields months where the INTAKE block prints month names.
